def test_basic_flow():
    c = controller.Controller()
    assert c.generation == 0
    
    gen1 = c.start()
    assert gen1 == 1
    assert c.busy == True
    
    # poll_status(1, "queued") -> False
    assert c.poll_status(1, "queued") is False
    assert c.busy == True
    
    # poll_status(1, "running") -> False
    assert c.poll_status(1, "running") is False
    assert c.busy == True
    
    # poll_status(1, "completed") -> True (the transition)
    assert c.poll_status(1, "completed") is True
    
    # poll_status(1, "completed") -> False (the "ONCE" part)
    assert c.poll_status(1, "completed") is False
    
    # finish(1, [1, 2]) -> True
    assert c.finish(1, [1, 2]) is True
    assert c.rows == [1, 2]
    assert c.busy == False
    
    # finish(1, [3, 4]) -> False (already finished)
    assert c.finish(1, [3, 4]) is False

def test_preservation():
    c = controller.Controller()
    c.rows = [0]
    c.decisions = {"a": 1}
    c.start()
    assert c.rows == [0]
    assert c.decisions == {"a": 1}

def test_failed_status():
    c = controller.Controller()
    c.start()
    c.poll_status(1, "failed")
    assert c.busy == False
    assert c.poll_status(1, "completed") is False

def test_stale_poll():
    c = controller.Controller()
    c.start() # gen 1
    # poll for gen 2
    assert c.poll_status(2, "completed") is False

def test_set_decision():
    c = controller.Controller()
    c.set_decision("job1", 100)
    assert c.decisions["job1"] == 100
    c.start()
    assert c.decisions["job1"] == 100

def test_unrequested_finish():
    c = controller.Controller()
    c.start()
    # finish without poll_status returning True
    assert c.finish(1, [1]) is False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_basic_flow()
    test_preservation()
    test_failed_status()
    test_stale_poll()
    test_set_decision()
    test_unrequested_finish()
    print("All tests passed!")
